description: Continuous unseasonal rainfall over 72 hours caused waterlogging and lodged standing wheat crop
aiRemarks: Satellite-derived NDVI anomaly confirms vegetative stress during flowering stage. Geo-tagged evidence coordinates match registered land parcel boundary. AWS rainfall deviation of +42mm recorded for the claim window.
assignedOfficer: Shri. S.S. Kulkarni, Taluka Agriculture Officer, Malegaon

reviewRemarks.remark: Vegetation index deviation of 0.28 detected against baseline. Yield loss estimated at 62%.

description: Pink bollworm infestation detected in Bollgard-II cotton at square formation stage. Pest pressure above ETL.
aiRemarks: Duplicate land parcel usage detected across multiple applications. Parcel LP-002 referenced in CLM-002 and an active claim from Kharif 2025. Recommended manual scrutiny of crop cycle eligibility.

description: Cloudburst on 06 May caused flash flooding. Soybean crop submerged for over 36 hours. Complete crop loss reported.
aiRemarks: Geo-tagged evidence and rainfall anomaly support flood damage claim. AWS station Tuljapur recorded 124mm in 24 hours against monthly normal of 38mm. CCE report confirms >75% yield loss. Eligible for PMFBY indemnity release.
assignedOfficer: Shri. R.P. Ghorpade, District Agriculture Officer, Osmanabad

reviewRemarks.remark: CCE conducted on 09 May. Plant count and pod formation confirm total loss. Intimate to Insurance Company.
Claim amount Rs. 62,400 approved under PMFBY. Reference forwarded to MahaDBT for disbursement.

description: Less than 40mm rainfall received during critical flowering stage. Crop wilted due to moisture stress.
aiRemarks: Satellite vegetation trend inconsistent with declared crop cycle. NDVI profile suggests crop was harvested prior to claimed loss period. Ground-truth verification recommended before re-evaluation.
assignedOfficer: Shri. S.S. Kulkarni, Taluka Agriculture Officer, Barshi

reviewRemarks.remark: Field visit conducted on 12 May. No standing crop evidence found. Land parcel appears fallow. Claim rejected under PMFBY clause 9(iii).

description: Wild boar and nilgai herd damaged mature maize crop over three consecutive nights. Estimated 60% crop loss.
aiRemarks: Parcel coordinates verified against Bhunaksha records. Crop stage consistent with reported sowing date. Wildlife intrusion claims require compensatory affidavit per Maharashtra Relief Manual.
